definitions.REVERSE: open full-size position in the Local direction (B1.0_SAFE_MAX_OOF_CAL early signal OR frozen V1 teacher)
definitions.PROTECT: exit an open position when the OPPOSITE side detector fires at B0.7_CAL_Q995
definitions.FALSE_RESET: exit when the entry Local's extreme is broken (lineage invalidation)
definitions.ideal: sum of |swing| between consecutive strict H1 Locals in the period (perfect Local->Local)
definitions.fee: 0.055% per side taker (0.11% round trip) in net column
definitions.captured_mfe_ratio(per signal): (next opposite Local - entry)/(next opposite Local - true Local)
